meta.purpose: Authoritative, machine-parseable task inventory for the full simulation/feature-coverage loop. Drive four engines (CanDo FEM, mrDNA, oxDNA, NAMD) to cover the four unconventional design features (extra crossover bases, linkers/overhang connections, E-fields, anchors) AND emit a shared, comparable set of prediction descriptors so engines cross-validate each other.
meta.reference_policy: per-observable: oxDNA is reference for relaxed shape + field-deflection; CanDo is reference for RMSF/flexibility; NAMD becomes gold for any observable once a NAMD run for that design exists (overrides).
meta.loop_invariant: The loop edits ONLY task.status and task.notes (and milestone.status, derived). It MUST NOT add, remove, reorder, or rewrite tasks, deps, oracles, or any other field. Scope changes, new tasks, or re-prioritization require the user. Seeded all-pending on purpose (nothing is 'done' until its oracle passes).
meta.three_layer_law: Every engine output here is PHYSICAL/display-only. Anchors + field specs are JOB-REQUEST annotations, never Design edits. CanDo extra-base/linker ELEMENTS are mesh-build details derived from existing topology metadata (Crossover.extra_bases, overhang_connections), not topology mutations.

tasks.notes: shape_metrics.py gained 3 engine-agnostic primitives (read-only over positions, no topology): deviation_profile(cand, ref, align=True) — per-nt deviation + rmsd_nm; align=True Kabsch (generalizes oxdna_health.geometry_deviation_map/measure_geometry_rmsd via _kabsch_superpose, strips rigid pose, shape survives), align=False direct key-match (generalizes cando_deviation.compute_deviation, exact residual). rmsf_from_ensemble(frames, align=True) — per-nt RMS fluctuation about the mean over a frame list (generalizes production_rmsf's variance core minus oxDNA file I/O; the trajectory-variance RMSF source for oxDNA/NAMD/mrDNA; CanDo supplies NMA rmsf directly). normalize_rmsf_profile — generalizes fem_solver.normalize_rmsf to a keyed [0,1] map from any {helix_id,bp_index,direction?,rmsf_nm} list (dir-less -> both strands). Copy-aware keys throughout. 10/10 fast oracle (tests/test_shape_deviation_rmsf.py): identical->rmsd 0, known non-rigid displacement recovered exactly (align=False), rigid pose removed by Kabsch, shear survives, A/sqrt(2) fluctuation round-trip, align=True strips bulk drift keeps site fluctuation, normalize max->1 + rescale-back + all-zero safe. No UI (card is S5). Ready for S3 compare_descriptors.

tasks.title: compare_descriptors(cand, ref) — per-observable reference selection + agreement math (scalar %delta, RMSF Pearson/Spearman, aligned-shape RMSD via _rigid_superpose)
tasks.oracle: identical inputs -> perfect agreement; known-perturbed input -> expected deltas/correlation; reference-selection honors per-observable policy incl. NAMD-override-when-present
tasks.notes: shape_metrics.py gained the cross-engine agreement layer (pure over Physical-layer dicts, no topology). compare_descriptors(candidate, reference, *, align_shape=True) scores agreement on the three comparable observable classes S1/S2 emit: (1) COMPARABLE_SCALARS (7 shape descriptors) -> {candidate, reference, abs_delta, signed_pct_delta} where pct = (cand-ref)/|ref|*100, None scalars incomparable, zero-ref -> abs_delta w/ None pct (no div0); (2) rmsf -> Pearson+Spearman over shared base pairs, {pearson, spearman, n, candidate/reference_mean_rmsf_nm}, degenerate (constant/<2 shared) -> None coeff not NaN; (3) shape_rmsd_nm via deviation_profile(align=True) Kabsch (rigid pose zeroed, real shape survives). reference_for(engines, observable) applies per-observable policy (shape/field->oxdna, rmsf->cando) with NAMD gold-override across all observables, missing engine/unknown observable -> None. KEY FIX (review-caught, HIGH): _rmsf_per_bp collapses BOTH profiles to per-(helix,bp,copy) mean over strand direction -- CanDo NMA RMSF is direction-less (1/bp) while ensemble RMSF is per-strand (2/bp); direction keying left the designated CanDo-vs-oxDNA pairing with an empty intersection (silent None). 13/13 fast oracle tests/test_shape_compare.py incl. the mixed-direction cross-engine case. No UI (card = S5). M-METRIC-CORE now S3 done; S4 (field-response, deps S1) + S5 (card, deps S3) remain.

tasks.title: Unified field-response descriptor (generalize oxdna_health.measure_field_response into shape_metrics: per-nt deflection map, free-region projection-along-field, anchored drift, magnitude ratio, cosine similarity)
tasks.oracle: synthetic anchored+deflected frame -> anchors held, free deflects along field, monotone in field magnitude; two-engine deflection cosine sim
tasks.notes: shape_metrics.py gained the engine-agnostic field-response layer (pure read-over-positions, no topology). field_response_profile(field_positions, reference_positions, field_dir, anchor_keys, *, anchor_tol_nm=1.0, min_free_proj_nm=0.5) generalizes oxdna_health.measure_field_response: reproduces its aggregates + physical verdict byte-for-byte (passed = anchored_max<=tol AND free_proj_along_field>=min; same two ValueErrors on zero field-dir / no free nts) and ADDS a copy-aware per_nt deflection map [{helix_id,bp_index,direction,copy,disp_vec_nm,disp_nm,proj_along_field_nm,anchored}] + a mean free deflection_vec_nm. NOT Kabsch-aligned (the anchored region IS the common frame; aligning would erase the measured motion). Keys via _dev_key (copy-distinct so inserted-base copies stay separate); anchor membership copy-AGNOSTIC (an anchored bp pins all its copies). compare_field_response(cand, ref) scores cross-engine deflection agreement over SHARED FREE nts: cosine_similarity (concatenated free disp vectors: identical->+1, opposite->-1, orthogonal->0) + magnitude_ratio (||cand||/||ref||: 3x compliance->3.0), None on degenerate/empty (n_shared_free=0). Both profiles normalize direction identically -> no S3-style silent-empty-intersection. 13/13 fast oracle tests/test_shape_field_response.py; full just test 4155 passed. No UI (field panel lands in the S5 card). S4 done -> M-METRIC-CORE only S5 remains.

tasks.title: Anchors: generalize apply_boundary_conditions from centroid-pin to pin selected nodes (Dirichlet BC); predict_shape(design, anchors=...); reuse oxDNA anchor scopes (cluster/domain/overhang) + resolve_anchor_particles-style resolver -> node indices
tasks.oracle: FAST: pinned nodes fixed (u==0 at pinned DOFs), free nodes move under a test load; free-free NMA preserved when no anchors. SLOW: real nonlinear solve on a fixture holds the anchor.
tasks.notes: Dirichlet anchors for the CanDo FEM (backend-only; anchors are a JOB-REQUEST annotation, never a Design/topology edit -- Three-Layer Law). apply_boundary_conditions(K,f,mesh,fixed_nodes=None) pins all 6 DOF of each anchor node; None OR empty list falls back to the legacy centroid pin (a stale selection that resolves to nothing never makes the system singular). solve_prestress_shape(...,fixed_nodes=) clamps them at every corotational load step -> the anchored region stays exactly at rest while the rest deflects under the loop/skip eigenstrain. resolve_anchor_nodes(design,mesh,anchors) reuses the SHARED oxDNA scope resolver (oxdna_interface.resolve_anchor_particles: overhang/cluster/domain/strand/base) -> per-nt (helix,bp,dir) keys collapsed onto the single duplex-core axis node per bp (both strands -> one node; out-of-core nts drop silently -- ssDNA ends, extra-base sentinel keys). predict_shape(design,*,anchors=None) threads anchors through BOTH nonlinear + linear paths and returns anchor_keys:[[helix,bp],...]. RMSF stays free-free NMA regardless (intrinsic flexibility; anchoring RMSF is a later refinement, not needed here). Oracle tests/test_cando_anchors.py 10 fast: synthetic beam pins held (u==0) & free tip moves under a test load; BC pins exactly the requested nodes / empty->centroid; resolver maps base+cluster scopes & drops stale; prestress solve holds the anchored node <1e-9 while the rest deflects >1e-3; unresolved anchor is a no-op (positions identical, free-free RMSF preserved via Pearson>0.999+mean-within-2% -- ARPACK no-v0 jitter, not an anchor effect). Fresh-context review: no correctness gaps (honest note: the free-free-RMSF assertion is green-by-construction since the RMSF path never receives anchors -- consistent w/ the stated oracle; positions no-op is the load-bearing check). Gates: 10/10 oracle, just test 4186 passed/66 skip/1 xfail (+1 known pre-existing job-archive xdist flaky, passes isolated), ruff clean on touched files. No card/UI -> display-vs-oracle N/A. main.js LOC delta=0. Substrate for C2 (E-field deflection needs an anchor to hold against).
